text:
DIAMETER::retry
Description
This iRules command tries to send the Diameter message contained in
the binary array “binary_message”. If the optional argument “across”
is specified as 1, the message will be sent across the proxy.
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
retry
"binary_message"
[
across
]
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DIAMETER_INGRESS
,
MR_INGRESS
